text:
An acute viral infection caused by an RNA virus of the genus Morbillivirus in the family Paramyxoviridae
Only one serotype is known and endemic throughout the world. A major contributor to childhood mortality, 79% reduction in deaths from measles due to the global push to improve vaccine coverage.
A major cause of preventable blindness. Transmission is by droplet infection during the prodromal stage
Incubation period: 9 - 11 days. Time of exposure to appearance of rash: about 14 days
